title: Redraw Nodes Ease Survives Fixture Effect
description: Nodes redraw camera RAF was cancelled on every fixture commit by useEffect([boardRedrawPlaying, fixture]) else branch; remove cancel so layout-started ease survives patchFixture.
summary: Root cause: useEffect([boardRedrawPlaying, fixture]) else-if (!suppress) cancelled boardPlayNodesRedrawCameraAnimRafRef on every fixture update, so after useLayoutEffect scheduled the nodes-redraw camera RAF, the same commit’s useEffect tore it down—instant jump to triptych. Removed that cancel; nodes RAF is still cleared on redraw play start, post-play override arm, override display effect, and layout cleanup.
